title: Accommodations by Classroom Context — Catalog
description: Index of accommodation files organized by where the accommodation applies in the school day (environment, transitions, language, peer/social, sensory, behavior, testing, etc.). Use to discover which context-based files might be relevant for a student-lesson modification. Source: ADayInOurShoes.

files.title: Behavior Accommodations
files.description: Reinforcement systems and task-structuring strategies that shape on-task and positive behavior.

files.title: Environment Accommodations
files.description: Physical and structural classroom accommodations: seating, distraction control, sensory adaptations, access to alternate spaces.

files.title: Language and Communication Accommodations
files.description: Adjustments to how teachers phrase, pace, and deliver verbal information.

files.title: Miscellaneous Accommodations for Cognitive and Academic Deficits
files.description: Cross-cutting interventions: reminders, scheduling supports, motivational structures, recognition-format alternatives.

files.title: People and Peer-Based Accommodations
files.description: Strategies that scaffold social interactions and use peers/adults as supports.

files.title: Sensory Accommodations
files.description: Supports for sensory regulation: movement breaks, awareness of environmental sensory inputs.

files.title: Testing and Assignment Accommodations
files.description: Modifications to how assignments and tests are presented, paced, and completed.

files.title: Tools and Equipment Accommodations
files.description: Physical tools, assistive technology, and learning aids the student can use during instruction.

files.title: Transition Accommodations
files.description: Accommodations for moving between activities, classrooms, or routines.
